archie.title: Archie
archie.subtitle: Groningen Archive Assistant
archie.welcome: Hello! I'm Archie, your archive assistant. I can help you find people in AlleGroningers, images in the Beeldbank (photos, maps, drawings, and prints), or historical collections in the Groningen Archives. What are you looking for today?
archie.placeholder: Ask about a person, place, or historical topic…
archie.tip: Tip: Try 'What is the oldest baptism in the Akerk?' or a family name.
archie.errorMessage: I'm sorry, I encountered an error. Please try again later.
